pages.text: $(o)As he fell, the vastness went out of him, and for a moment he was only a man in a crown, very tired.$(br2)"I held it for them," he said, "because no one should hold it alone. Now no one has to."$()
pages.title: Vael's Last Words
The Sovereign's Crown
pages.text: Kept anywhere in your inventory:$(li)Corruption can no longer $(l)harm$() you. It still gathers, and still matters, but the whispers, the darkness and the withering are silenced.$(li)Your mana returns $(l)twice$() as fast.
This is the final secret of the Hollow, and of this journal: corruption was never a wall. It was a weight. Vael proved it could be carried.$(br2)Carry it well.$(br2)$(o)- the last of the Circle$()
